what_happened: Scene layout 6 (speckled granite counter, toaster oven, robot right of the dishwasher; same kitchen as s16 and s25), red cup_4 and black bowl_5. Stage 0: cup grasped 144-152 (lift 0.047), released on the slid-out rack at 251 where it fell onto its side (tipped 262-1200); stage 0 complete 251 (fast, median 298). Stage 1: instead of going to the bowl, the arm rose and wandered for ~700 steps: 290-360 it looked at the rack/door from the left side, 450-850 it pointed up and to the right at the upper cabinets, the toaster oven and the backsplash (wrist: cabinet doors, wall outlet, toaster), with no contact with any task object. From ~900 it came back to the black bowl on the counter and hovered above it; it closed on air at 1064, then closed on the bowl's rim at 1167, tilted it (tilt up to 44 deg, lift 0.019) and lost it at 1187; the bowl settled back upright where it started. At 1200 the gripper was empty, heading back toward the rack. The door was never touched.
causal_chain: cup placed at 251 (fast) -> ~600 steps wandering at the upper cabinets/toaster 290-900 -> bowl approached only at ~900-1060 -> miss on air (1064) and rim pinch that slipped (1167-1187) -> timeout with the bowl on the counter
self_recovery: The policy did return to the bowl at ~900 and tried twice; neither attempt held.
official_criterion_notes: The cup counts as on the rack while lying on its side (tilt 56 deg).
uncertain_about: Why the policy wandered; the black bowl on the dark speckled counter is visible in the agent view but may be hard to pick out (cf. s6, s25 with the same black bowl_5).
